cond_0001.intro: The Quality Engineer is responsible for plans and develops activities concerned with development, application, and maintenance of quality standards for instructional processes, materials, and products by performing the following duties:
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Support on-site audits conducted by customers.
Work closely with internal stakeholders, including engineering, and manufacturing teams, to communicate quality requirements and resolve supplier-related issues.
Visits and confers with representatives of material and component vendors to obtain information related to supply quality.
Support investigation of customer complaints, lead cross-functional problem-solving teams with focused root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
Resolve quality issues by identifying problems, examining solution options, implementing action plans, and verifies effectiveness.
Plan, conduct, and monitor tests and inspections on materials and products to ensure the quality of finished products.
Provide quality support to quality manager for customer & supplier issue resolution.
Work collaboratively with Engineering to complete the PPAP package for the introduction of new projects and engineering changes.
Leads Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) teams and the development of Control Plans.
Collaborate with manufacturing teams to reach long-term corrective action on quality issues and support the development of new processes.
Inform the quality management team regarding customer feedback.
Assist in new product development activities to avoid quality issues.
Follow up activities on a daily basis with quality inspectors.
Performs other duties as assigned by Quality Manager.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent years of experience.
1-3 Years of experience in quality or related roles in the manufacturing industry.
Knowledge of quality tools used in the industry.
Experience in statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external suppliers and customers.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in automotive manufacturing.
Recent college graduates will be considered.

cond_0346.intro: The Quality Engineer is responsible for plans and develops activities concerned with development, application, and maintenance of quality standards for instructional processes, materials, and products by performing the following duties. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of quality systems and problem-solving work it involves.
cond_0346.responsibilities:
Support on-site audits conducted by customers.
Work closely with internal stakeholders, including engineering, and manufacturing teams, to communicate quality requirements and resolve supplier-related issues.
Visits and confers with representatives of material and component vendors to obtain information related to supply quality.
Support investigation of customer complaints, lead cross-functional problem-solving teams with focused root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
Resolve quality issues by identifying problems, examining solution options, implementing action plans, and verifies effectiveness.
Plan, conduct, and monitor tests and inspections on materials and products to ensure the quality of finished products.
Provide quality support to quality manager for customer & supplier issue resolution.
Work collaboratively with Engineering to complete the PPAP package for the introduction of new projects and engineering changes.
Leads Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) teams and the development of Control Plans.
Collaborate with manufacturing teams to reach long-term corrective action on quality issues and support the development of new processes.
Inform the quality management team regarding customer feedback.
Assist in new product development activities to avoid quality issues.
Follow up activities on a daily basis with quality inspectors.
Performs other duties as assigned by Quality Manager.
cond_0346.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent years of experience.
1-3 Years of experience in quality or related roles in the manufacturing industry.
Knowledge of quality tools used in the industry.
Experience in statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in automotive manufacturing.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external suppliers and customers.
Recent college graduates will be considered.
cond_0346.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.

cond_0564.intro: The Quality Engineer is responsible for plans and develops activities concerned with development, application, and maintenance of quality standards for instructional processes, materials, and products by performing the following duties:
cond_0564.responsibilities:
Support on-site audits conducted by customers.
Stay in regular contact with internal stakeholders, including engineering and manufacturing teams, to communicate quality requirements and resolve supplier-related issues.
Visit and confer with representatives of material and component vendors to obtain information related to supply quality.
Support investigation of customer complaints, lead cross-functional problem-solving teams with focused root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
Resolve quality issues by identifying problems, examining solution options, implementing action plans, and verifying effectiveness.
Plan, conduct, and monitor tests and inspections on materials and products to ensure the quality of finished products.
Provide quality support to quality manager for customer and supplier issue resolution.
Work collaboratively with Engineering to complete the PPAP package for the introduction of new projects and engineering changes.
Lead Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) teams and the development of Control Plans.
Collaborate with manufacturing teams to reach long-term corrective action on quality issues and support the development of new processes.
Keep the quality management team informed of customer feedback on an ongoing basis.
Actively contribute to new product development activities to avoid quality issues.
Follow up daily with quality inspectors.
Perform other duties as assigned by Quality Manager.
cond_0564.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent years of experience.
1-3 Years of experience in quality or related roles in the manufacturing industry.
Knowledge of quality tools used in the industry.
Strong communication skills with the ability to regularly engage with internal teams and external suppliers and customers.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in automotive manufacturing.
Experience in statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies.
Recent college graduates will be considered.
